title: Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.22657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI frameworks interpret open-ended task goals and decompose them into multi-step plans. Richer information about embodiment-specific capabilities, physical preconditions, and cross-robot coordination improves grounding, but does not eliminate infeasible, mistimed, or unsafe physical actions. Physical robot crews therefore require an explicit architectural interface between semantic planning and execution, where every planned action is verified against robot capabilities, system state, and workflow constraints before actuation. This paper introduces Physical Agentic AI, a framework for skill-grounded robot agent orchestration, in which each robot exposes a typed library of executable skills while a foundation model planner decomposes a task into phases and assigns each phase to a robot-skill pair. A Robot Orchestration layer exposes the skill library, robot state, named locations, and workflow contracts to a non-actuating Missio

translated_title: 物理智能体人工智能：用大语言模型编排机器人团队的架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22657v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能体AI框架解释开放式任务目标并将其分解为多步骤计划。关于具身特定能力、物理前置条件和跨机器人协调的更丰富信息改善了基础性，但并不能消除不可行、时机不当或不安全的物理动作。因此，物理机器人团队需要在语义规划与执行之间建立一个明确的架构接口，其中每个计划动作在驱动前必须经过机器人能力、系统状态和工作流约束的验证。本文介绍了物理智能体人工智能，这是一种基于技能基础的机器人智能体编排框架，其中每个机器人暴露一个可执行技能的典型库，而基础模型规划器将任务分解为阶段，并将每个阶段分配给一个机器人-技能对。一个机器人编排层将技能库、机器人状态、命名位置和工作流契约暴露给一个非驱动性的任务……
tldr: 本文提出了一种物理智能体AI架构，通过在语义规划与执行之间加入验证接口，确保每个机器人动作在执行前都经过能力、状态和约束检查，从而提升物理机器人团队的安全性与协调性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Physical Agentic AI architecture that adds a verification interface between semantic planning and execution, ensuring every robot action is checked against capabilities, state, and constraints before actuation, enhancing safety and coordination in physical robot crews.
